replies.author: noobtheloser
replies.body:
Many of the examples you've listed aren't significantly using player-facing generated assets. The two that do so flagrantly, COD6 and Lost Ark, have drawn significant criticism from the anti-AI crowd, though this has obviously not significantly affected the success of the games.

Though I understand it's tempting to dismiss nuance, there's a meaningful difference to opponents of generative AI between using it to ideate internally with paid artists and designers versus pushing a product that is almost entirely player-facing generated assets.

In the case of Stellaris, they even pay royalties to the original voice actors for lines generated based upon their work.
